text:
ian: Heads up — console sparklines + metrics panels started freezing on canary after yesterday's prefetch routing change. Repro on EU canary, dashboards with many small series hang and bundle evicts repeatedly. Anyone seen this?

deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026-03-19T22:41 (commit abc1234) applied to eu-canary. Feature flags: prefetch-routing=v2, telemetry-proxy=enabled.
marta: Yup saw it ~10:30 UTC this morning. Repro steps: open customer metrics page -> filter to 'response_latency' -> panel never finishes rendering (spinner stays). CPU thread shows heavy main-thread parse then immediate KV cache eviction loop.
sam: Browser console and runtime logs pasted below:
```
[2026-03-20T10:28:12Z] kvcache.js:evict key=panel-42-prefix size=8MB reason=affinity_conflict
[2026-03-20T10:28:12Z] prefetch-router:route -> chosen=eu-1 (round_robin->affinity_mismatch)
[2026-03-20T10:28:12Z] bundle-loader:fetch /static/chunks/metrics-heavy-abc.js 304 34ms
[2026-03-20T10:28:13Z] kvcache.js:evict key=panel-42-prefix size=9MB reason=affinity_conflict
[2026-03-20T10:28:13Z] perf:main-thread-blocked 2100ms
```
sam: Also seeing repeated network `304` for the new split chunk which suggests cache miss -> refetch loop.

ian: I diffed the prefetch routing config — we flipped `bindAffinity: true` -> `bindAffinity: false` for v2 to improve distribution. That probably broke our stable keying for panels and caused eviction churn. Config snippet:```json
{"prefetch": {"strategy": "windowed", "bindAffinity": false, "batchWindowMs": 30}}
```

alex: Oof. That explains the eviction loop. Two immediate options: rollback prefetch-routing to v1 OR temporarily disable `prefetch-window` for heavy metric panels. If we want a quick mitigation: flip feature flag `console-prefetch=v2 -> v1` for canary and prod. Command:```bash
redwood feature toggle console-prefetch --env eu-canary --set v1
```

jess: I'll open the rollback PR for the routing change and a follow-up to add a fallback: if eviction rate > 0.2 within 10s for a panel, disable prefetch for that panel. Also will add a metric `console.kvcache.evictions_per_minute` tagged by panel_id + canary/prod.
sre-bot: Alert: console.kvcache.evictions spike (eu-canary) - 2026-03-20T10:29 -> 350/min (baseline 2/min). See: https://obs.redwood.local/alerts/EVICT-324
marta: Note: this seems to only affect panels with >20 series and multi-tenant dashboards where prefix key collisions happen. Single-series panels unaffected.
sam: Another low-effort mitigation: reduce the new split chunk size by making the heavy renderer lazy (defer render until user interaction) — that avoids the immediate bundle parse stall. But that's a slower UI change.
jess: Plan: (1) toggle feature to v1 on canary now, (2) rollback route change PR and test on canary, (3) add eviction metrics + panel-level prefetch safety switch, (4) follow-up UX change to lazy-load heavy renderer. I'll push the PR and ping here.
ian: Thanks — please @eng-sre when the toggle goes live so we can watch evictions. For postmortem: add a preflight check in the rollout job that verifies kvcache.evictions remain < 5/min for 5m after canary.
jenkins-bot: job(console-rollout-preflight) started for PR #4289
jess: PR created: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4289 — rollback prefetch-routing -> v1, includes metrics plumbing. Will monitor.
marta: After the toggle to v1 on canary the spinner cleared for me within 30s. Will keep testing on larger datasets.
ian: OK keeping this thread pinned. If prod toggle needed we'll follow the same steps. Thanks all :thumbsup:
